forks.title: Backend database
forks.summary: Picking storage for habits, streaks and reminders
forks.quote: Here are four solid options for the data layer

options.name: PostgreSQL
options.summary: Adopted; schema for habits and check-ins is done
options.quote: Postgres is the safe default for relational data

options.name: SQLite
options.summary: Simplest for a local-first prototype or an offline mobile build
options.quote: SQLite is the fastest way to a working prototype

options.name: MongoDB
options.summary: Turn 3: you ruled it out, streak queries need joins
options.quote: MongoDB if the habit schema keeps changing

options.name: Supabase
options.summary: Turn 4: you want to revisit it if hosting gets annoying
options.quote: Supabase gives you Postgres plus auth out of the box

forks.title: ORM
forks.quote: Three ORMs fit well with Postgres and TypeScript

options.name: Prisma
options.quote: Prisma has the smoothest schema workflow

options.name: Kysely
options.summary: Type-safe query builder if you want no ORM at all
options.quote: Kysely if you just want typed SQL

forks.title: Authentication
forks.quote: You have three realistic paths for auth

options.name: Magic links
options.quote: Magic links keep signup to one field

options.name: OAuth with Google and Apple
options.summary: Turn 10: add once the mobile app ships
options.quote: Sign in with Apple is required on iOS

options.name: Email and password
options.summary: Turn 10: you don't want to handle resets
options.quote: Classic email and password is the most familiar

forks.title: Landing page angle
forks.quote: Pick one of these angles for the hero

options.name: Streaks that forgive missed days
options.summary: Lead with the gentler streak mechanic
options.quote: Streaks that forgive a missed day

options.name: Ten-second daily check-in
options.quote: Check in for the day in ten seconds

options.name: Private by default
options.quote: Your habits never leave your account
